investigations.question: What killed the pilot at x=141, and what holds it at/below x~300 for the rest of the 90s (timeout at maxX 301, crown x=2050)? Stored evidence has no death cause/events, no input trace, no position trace, no gameplay frames, and no per-run retention (repeatedFlaws empty), so a bot-policy defect cannot be distinguished from a reproducible design block. The lone death with no hotspot leans bot-policy-unproven, but the stall itself is unattributed.
investigations.smallestNextStep: Bounded capture rerun with death events (hazard id/cause/phase at x=141), input history, a position/stall trace, and retained gameplay frames of the x~141 encounter including telegraph visibility in the frames before the death; repeat across fresh starts/phases. Only if the stall or the blind read repeats in captured play may a level edit be proposed.
